node.title: Re: Loading PERL Module from scalar in RAM?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Although I'm having a hard time imagining what you might need this for, and I think it'd be better if you explained that and showed us a [id://1177642|SSCCE]: [doc://use] [id://1199713|is like] BEGIN { require Module; Module->import( LIST ); }, and [doc://require] is like a [doc://do] which first checks if the file has already been loaded (via [doc://%INC]), and [doc://do] is like a fancy [doc://eval]. So the answer to your question is likely* [doc://eval], although of course that comes with serious security considerations if the code being executed is not 100% under your control.

* Update: The [doc://@INC] hook mentioned by the others is certainly a possible solution as well.
